Package io.github._3xhaust.platform.swing

Class SwingRenderer

java.lang.Object
io.github._3xhaust.platform.swing.SwingRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Renderer
public class SwingRenderer extends Object implements Renderer
Swing-backed implementation of Renderer. The renderer keeps an explicit stack of containers as widgets are visited; each widget pushes a Swing container, renders its children into it, then pops.

Supports coalesced rebuilds via requestRebuild() - any number of setState calls during a frame produce a single re-render on the EDT.
